Package hec.lang

Class NamedType

java.lang.Object
java.util.Observable
hec.lang.NamedType
All Implemented Interfaces:
AsciiSerializable, FieldAccessor, Serializable, Cloneable, Comparable, Observer, rma.lang.Modifiable
Direct Known Subclasses:
AbstractConditionalBlockRef, AbstractDataObject, AbstractTSRecord, AdjustableParameter, BaseAltGlobalData, BaseGlobalVariable, CapacityOutage, CapacitySchedule, Conditional, ConditionalBlock, Controller, hec.watershed.model.DefaultDataList, DiversionOp, Element, G2dLine, Identifier, Manager, Node, OpControllableElement, OpControllableObject, OpControllerZones, OpRuleRef, OpSetRef, OpSupportConfig, OpSupportModelVariable, OpSupportTabConfig, PDCRecordImpl, PowerPlant, Pump, ReleaseAllocationSet, ReportInterval, ResSystemOpSet, RssOutput, RssTSLocationObject, SchedulableJob, ScriptGroup, ScriptIdentifier, StorageZone, StorageZoneRules, StreamElement, StreamJunction, StreamNode, SystemOpController, SystemOpRule, SystemOpRuleRef, SystemReservoirStorage, SystemStorageZone, TsVariant, UnitsType, UnmodifiableDataObject, UserInfo, UserLoginInfo, WatershedLocation, ZoneBounds
public abstract class NamedType extends Observable implements Serializable, Cloneable, AsciiSerializable, Observer, rma.lang.Modifiable, Comparable
NamedType serves as a superclass for Objects that need a name and description. Extends java.util.Observable so that any of the derived objects from NamedType (ie hec.io.Manager) can register observers.
